observable_and_independence_notes: E29 frequency, cell production and spacing come from the same root records; production and spacing share a mature cortical cell-length denominator. The figure does not restore root IDs or pair markers between panels.
Overlapping figure markers are not reconstructed. The panels are not two independent biological samples; no composite likelihood, AIC, biological p value or biological confidence interval is used.

De Gernier et al. (2025), accepted manuscript p.10 and Fig.1, place the DR5::LUC peak after initial priming, near the distal elongation zone. Both E29 and E34 transfer a reporter observable, not a directly measured first-return time. A constant reporter delay alone would not change the period; constancy across interventions is not assumed here.

The source paper's finite-event-count correction of free spacing cannot be reconstructed without the root-specific peak counts. The registered E29 delta is an empirical offset, not an independent measurement of L or pathway length.
All E29 holdout outcomes and all E34 genotypes were already known before E77. The historical partitions are reused for an exploratory comparison, not a fresh blind prediction.

fit_parameter_accounting.E34: Only tau or b is transferred; every law uses target WT v0,T0. No four-target coefficient fitting. L is absorbed into the WT growth scale.

E34_reading_sensitivity.registered_scope: Reproduction of the original three models' existing reading-corner ranges and comparison count.
E34_reading_sensitivity.power_comparison_note_ja: 登録後の補助解析（既存の1,024端点設定をそのまま流用）。主判定には用いない。
E34_reading_sensitivity.interpretation: Fixed image-reading corners, not random draws, biological replicates or coverage probabilities.

E34_mature_cell_length_sensitivity.interpretation: Hypothetical target/WT cell-length ratios, not a measured distribution. The identical q transformation is given to all growth-dependent models. WT remains q=1. Common endpoint conditions and all-equal endpoint corners are deliberately both retained.

tau_training_SSE_profile.interpretation: Training-SSE tolerance sets; no biological confidence interval. All 401 rows, including invalid target predictions, are retained. A tau at or above WT period loses the positive growth-wait interpretation.

interpretation_limits: The additive waiting-time law is also generated by an open supply or local recovery schedule. Its predictive ranking does not identify a molecular return path or toroidal geometry.
A better empirical power law would not show that circulation is absent. A worse power law would not exclude all non-return mechanisms.
Tau-profile minima use low-production frequency only. No target outcome selects a preferred tau; all registered grid rows and predictions are saved.
Marker reading errors, SSE tolerance sets and hypothetical cell-length ranges are different kinds of sensitivity and are not biological sampling uncertainty.
